formulaBlock.normalization: Aqua (Water, Eau) one entry; positions = packet order (normalized, one-based).

cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate (C1): Sodium Laureth Sulfate (2) defining anionic, buffered by Cocamidopropyl Betaine (4); no reinforcing strong anionic. Coco-Glucoside (13) is post-fragrance and not a buffer.
cleansingStrength.counterSignal: Only one prominent buffer; refatters are post-fragrance.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate: one meaningful cationic system Polyquaternium-10 (10) with light routes: Hydrolyzed Silk (6), Sericin (7), Glycosphingolipids (5), PEG-7 Glyceryl Cocoate (9), Glyceryl Oleate (15), Glycol Distearate (17), Hydrogenated Castor Oil (18), Prunus Armeniaca Kernel Oil (21). C2 not met: no early silicone or prominent payload lipid, and no listed humectant.
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: Many light routes could add up (neighbor high is not realistic without silicone); the realistic alternative is low because PQ-10 is post-fragrance and lipids are trace.

weightPotential.rationale: Low: one post-fragrance Polyquaternium-10 plus light proteins, weak refatters and trace late lipids, facing an effective buffered SLES chassis; no silicone and no prominent lipid.

depositionLoad.rationale: PQ-10 (10), silk/sericin (6, 7), weak refatters (5, 9, 15), lipids at 18 and 21.

persistence.rationale: Hydrolyzed proteins and refatters weakly retained; HCO and apricot oil trace.

weak_refatter.note: lipid-like additive, read as weak refatter

weightPotential.whyThisBand: Light, mostly post-fragrance routes and moderate reset: low anchor.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: W2: four families are present, but the only polymer (PQ-10) is post-fragrance, the proteins are hydrolyzed, the refatters are weak esters and the two lipids sit at 18 and 21 behind pearlizer and solubilizer (trace, likely pearl-concentrate carry-over); with no silicone and an effective SLES chassis their combined residue is unlikely to be noticeable.
weightPotential.limitingFactor: Number of families and the waxy HCO keep moderate realistic.

focusPrimary.rationale: Pending claims. Care-direction verdict provisional: nonspecific leaning repair (silk proteins, sericin, glycosphingolipids, PQ-10 form a light substantive cluster but no strong deposition system).

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: CSA formula half NOT met: no prominent E4 comfort or humectant route (PEG-7 Glyceryl Cocoate 9 is listed but post-fragrance).

dandruffSupport.rationale: Neither Piroctone Olamine nor Climbazole in the complete INCI.

uncertainties: Glycosphingolipids (5) read as a lipid-like weak refatter rather than a payload lipid; as a payload lipid it would be prominent but not converge with silicone (none) and only weakly with post-fragrance PQ-10, so W-RICH would be borderline. Recorded as a reason for moderate weight confidence.
